artists.biography: Monster Magnet is an American stoner rock band. Hailing from Red Bank, New Jersey, the group was founded by Dave Wyndorf (vocals and guitar), John McBain (guitar) and Tim Cronin (vocals and drums). The band first went by the names "Dog of Mystery", "Airport 75", "Triple Bad Acid" and "King Fuzz" before finally settling on "Monster Magnet", taken from the name of a 1960s toy made by Wham-O, which Wyndorf liked when he was a child.

perplexity.description:
Last Patrol," released on October 15, 2013, is the ninth studio album by American rock band Monster Magnet, issued through Napalm Records (original label Spinning Goblin Productions is sometimes noted but the official release was via Napalm). The album marks a return to a more psychedelic and space rock-influenced sound, blending heavy rock riffs with vintage-inspired textures. Produced by frontman Dave Wyndorf and guitarist Phil Caivano, "Last Patrol" was recorded with an emphasis on a homegrown, organic feel at Caivano’s Studio 13, reflecting the band’s shared love for classic rock styles and a raw, energetic performance from all members.

In the context of Monster Magnet’s discography, "Last Patrol" stands out as a revitalization of their earlier stoner and psychedelic rock roots, following a period of experimentation and lineup changes. It received generally positive reviews for its cohesive sound and return to form, appealing to longtime fans of the band’s 1990s work. The album was supported by a North American tour, their first in over a decade, signaling a renewed commitment to live performance and engagement with their audience. While not a major commercial breakthrough, "Last Patrol" reinforced Monster Magnet’s status in the rock scene as purveyors of heavy, spacey rock with a vintage edge.
